Što propisuje javni poziv: What the public call sets out
Javni poziv EnU-2/26 Fonda za zaštitu ok: Public call EnU-2/26 of the Environmental Protection and Energy Efficiency Fund was published on 9 October 2026. After postponements, applications are scheduled to open on Thursday 5 November at 9:00 via the eFZOEU system. The grant for electric passenger cars is up to 40% of the eligible price, subject to fixed caps. Before applying, check the latest amendments and documents on the Fund's official website.
Pravo imaju punoljetne fizičke osobe s p: Eligible applicants are adults resident in Croatia, for one eligible vehicle. Hybrids and electric bicycles are not covered. The vehicle must be new; purchase with own funds or a loan and financial leasing are eligible under the terms of the call. Operating leases are not eligible. The grant is paid after the vehicle has been bought and registered and the required proof submitted. Financing for the purchase must therefore be arranged in advance, with special rules for financial leasing described below.
<strong>Važno:</strong> Nakon podnošenja: Important: Once submitted, an application cannot be changed or supplemented, and the same applicant cannot submit a new one. Applications are processed in the order received. Prepare the required documents before applications open. Final eligibility depends on the Fund's conditions and the individual application.
Vozilo u cijelosti plaćeno prije objave: A vehicle paid in full before the call was published on 9 October 2026 is not eligible. A deposit is eligible if it was incurred and paid no earlier than 1 January 2026; paying a deposit is not required to apply. The vehicle must be bought and registered by 31 March 2028, and the complete payment request submitted by 30 April 2028. The vehicle must be kept in ownership or use for two years from the date the Fund pays out.
Kod financijskog leasinga korisnik prije: With financial leasing, before requesting payment the beneficiary must pay the down payment and instalments totalling at least the approved grant. Remaining obligations under the lease must be settled no later than five years from the date the grant is paid (FZOEU, answer 12). Financing for the full purchase must be arranged, but leasing does not require paying the full price before the grant is paid.

Da, kupnja u drugoj državi EU-a prihvatl: Yes, buying in another EU country is eligible according to the Fund's clarification.
Vozilo mora ispuniti definiciju novog vo: The vehicle must meet the call's definition of a new vehicle, be type-approved for road use in Croatia and, after purchase, be registered for the first time in Croatia. A previous regular registration in another country is not eligible. The Fund does not regard trade, export (for example Zoll) or transferable plates as registration for the purposes of the call. Documents in a foreign language require a translation into Croatian certified by a sworn court interpreter.
Kod kupnje novog vozila iz EU-a u prijav: When buying a new vehicle from the EU, the application states the vehicle's value including Croatian VAT. An advertised foreign price should therefore not automatically be compared with the Croatian price on the invoice. Ask for an offer that clearly separates the vehicle price, VAT and additional costs.
Dostava i homologacija nisu dodatni poti: Delivery and type approval are not an extra grant.
Troškovi dostave, pripreme, homologacije: Costs of delivery, preparation, type approval, issuing the COC, documentation and other related costs that are not part of the vehicle price are not included in the co-financing base. Compare the total cost of getting the car on the road, including translation and transport, and ask the seller for written confirmation of the registration history.

Financing for the purchase must therefore be arranged in advance, with special rules for financial leasing described below.
Probušena guma, otpušten vijak ili prego: A punctured tyre, a loose bolt or a blown fuse can interrupt even a well-planned trip. A small, tried-and-tested toolkit helps with simple problems. Alongside the list, we outline equipment for travel through selected European countries.
Nosi alat kojim znaš rukovati i koji odg: Carry tools you know how to use and that fit your motorcycle. A serious electronics, clutch or gearbox fault usually requires a workshop. Before departure, check whether your roadside assistance covers the countries on your route, motorcycle recovery and any onward travel.
Probušena guma: što može putni komplet: A punctured tyre: what a travel kit can do
Putni komplet može privremeno pomoći kod: A travel kit may provide a temporary solution for a small puncture in the central tread area of a tubeless tyre. Sidewall or shoulder damage, a tear, bead damage or a tyre that will not hold pressure requires professional help and motorcycle recovery.
Čep je samo privremeno rješenje za odlaz: A plug is only a temporary solution for reaching the nearest specialist, subject to the tyre and repair-kit manufacturers’ limits. If the repair is appropriate and the tyre holds the specified pressure, ride carefully to a workshop. A final assessment requires an internal inspection after the tyre has been removed from the rim.
Rezervne žarulje za svjetla sa zamjenjiv: Spare bulbs for lights with replaceable filaments, as a practical backup
Prije puta provjeri pristaje li svaki kl: Before the trip, check that each tool fits the bolts and nuts you might need to access: on the wheels, mirrors, battery cover, seat and luggage mounts. Do not loosen axles or other safety-critical fasteners just to test your tools. If you do dismantle a joint, reassemble it according to the service instructions and specified tightening torque. The factory toolkit may be a good starting point, but check that it covers the required sizes.
Komplet prilagođen gumama: čepovi za tub: A kit suited to your tyres: plugs for tubeless tyres or inner-tube repair supplies, plus a compressor or CO₂ cartridges
Žarulje za zamjenjiva svjetla i ulje ako: Bulbs for replaceable lights and oil if your motorcycle consumes it
Pravila za motocikle razlikuju se od oni: Motorcycle rules differ from those for cars. This is an overview of selected requirements and recommendations for travel, rather than a complete set of traffic regulations. It draws on ÖAMTC and FEMA guides; national sources for Croatia, Germany and French protective equipment are also listed at the end of the article.
Kratka svjetla upaljena danju tijekom ci: Dipped headlights must be on during the day throughout the year. Spare bulbs are not mandatory motorcycle equipment under Article 99 of Croatia’s vehicle technical requirements regulation.
Reflektirajući prsluk, i za suvozača; pr: A high-visibility vest, including for the passenger; a first aid kit according to FEMA’s guide.
Reflektirajući prsluk, i za suvozača. Vo: A high-visibility vest, including for the passenger. Rider and passenger must wear an approved helmet with four reflective elements and CE-marked motorcycle gloves. The vest must be accessible and worn when stepping onto the carriageway or roadside after an emergency stop.
ÖAMTC ne navodi posebne obveze nošenja o: ÖAMTC lists no specific requirement to carry this additional equipment. Daytime lighting is mandatory in all three countries. In Germany, dipped headlights or daytime running lights are permitted during the day; dipped headlights are required in reduced visibility.
Prsluk za svaku osobu i mala prva pomoć: A vest for each person and a small first aid kit are practical choices for the whole trip. The ÖAMTC and FEMA guides differ for Slovenia and Hungary: FEMA also lists a vest for Slovenia and first aid supplies for Hungary. Before travelling, check national regulations, including whether individual requirements apply to foreign-registered motorcycles.
Za šest dana po asfaltu dobar su početak: For six days on tarmac, a kit suited to your tyre type, a few correctly sized tools, consumables, a vest and a first aid kit are a good starting point. Adapt your equipment to the motorcycle, route and your skills, and check the terms and limits of your roadside assistance before departure.

Zvuk, odziv gasa i karakter agregata: št: Sound, throttle response and engine character: what gets lost as motorcycles become cleaner and screens get bigger?
Euro norme: čist ispuh, prazna duša: Euro standards: clean exhaust, empty soul
Crvena Vespa na kamenoj ulici pred stari: Red Vespa on a cobbled street in front of old buildings
Motocikl može biti brži, čišći i opremlj: A motorcycle can be faster, cleaner and better equipped than ever, yet give you less pleasure. What remains when the sound fades, the response is smoothed out and a Netflix-sized screen grows above the handlebars?
Crvena Vespa u staroj gradskoj ulici. Te: Red Vespa on an old city street. Thematic photograph: Callum Hilton / Pexels · Pexels licence. The photograph does not necessarily depict Milan.
Na motocikl se sjeda i zbog onoga što se: We also ride motorcycles for things a catalogue cannot capture. The way the engine pulls out of a corner. The sound of the intake as you open the throttle. The rhythm you feel through the seat and handlebars.
Zato slabiji motocikl može ostaviti više: That is why a less powerful motorcycle can leave more memories than one that beats it in every category on paper. And it keeps inviting you to ride the same road again.
Zvuk je dio vožnje: Sound is part of the ride
Rasprava o zvuku prebrzo završi na prazn: Discussions about sound turn too quickly to straight pipes and neighbours who cannot sleep. Yet there is plenty of room between a characterless hum and making an entire street miserable.
Zvuk ima boju, ritam i način na koji ras: Sound has a tone, a rhythm and a way of building with the revs. The pulse of a twin, the changing note of a four-cylinder engine, the intake under load: all contribute to the experience. You can enjoy listening to an interesting engine at perfectly normal speeds.
Kad se taj glas izgubi, motocikl postaje: When that voice disappears, the motorcycle becomes anonymous, and the rider loses part of the pleasure that made them get on it in the first place. Efficiency simply cannot replace feeling.
Tu treba biti precizan: Euro 5 ograničav: Precision matters here: Euro 5 limits harmful exhaust emissions, while noise is also governed by separate type-approval requirements. The final sound also depends on intake and exhaust design. The Euro label therefore cannot explain every change we dislike.
Ipak, kupac vidi konačan rezultat. Sasvi: Nevertheless, the buyer sees the final result. It is perfectly reasonable to expect a factory-standard, type-approved motorcycle to have a sound you want to hear again.
Karakter počinje pod desnim dlanom: Character starts beneath your right hand
Karakter je i način na koji motor odgova: Character is also the way an engine responds. How it pulls from low revs, where it comes alive and how much it encourages you to reach for the next gear. Those differences make people choose particular engines and remain loyal to them for years.
Elektronički gas proizvođaču daje mnogo: Electronic throttle control gives manufacturers considerable freedom to shape that relationship. It can deliver a precise, natural response. It can also make you feel as if someone between your hand and the rear wheel is constantly adjusting your throttle cable.
Nostalgia can easily flatter the past. A snatchy throttle, numb fingers and a morning struggle to get started are not qualities worth preserving. What deserves to survive is whatever puts a spark in your eye when you ride, while removing what makes riding unnecessarily difficult.
Koliko za sve možemo kriviti Euro 5?: How much can we blame on Euro 5?
Čišći ispuh je stvaran dobitak. Ali stro: Cleaner exhaust is a real gain. But stricter requirements also mean more development, testing and design changes. Their effect on the choice of engines is particularly interesting: is it worth developing something distinctive for fewer buyers, or is it easier to offer another version of an existing, developed design?
To je pitanje koje zaslužuje raspravu. Z: That question deserves discussion. We do not need old statistics about motorcycles accounting for a small share of CO₂ to have it. Climate emissions and substances that harm health in cities are different issues.
Odgovornost imaju i proizvođači. Propisi: Manufacturers share the responsibility. Regulations set the conditions; development teams and management decide what to build within them. When a motorcycle loses what people loved about it, the word ecology is too little of an explanation.
Želim da se prepoznatljivost agregata tr: I want an engine's recognisable character to be treated as a development goal. Just as seriously as power, fuel consumption and equipment.
Dok raspravljamo o onome što više ne čuj: While we discuss what we can no longer hear, something above the handlebars is growing harder and harder to ignore.
Još malo pa će na predstavljanju putnog: Soon touring-bike launches will explain how well the display handles dark scenes and whether Netflix comes as standard. The handlebars get more buttons, the menus gain more layers, and the rider gets homework before the first trip.
Dobar zaslon s čitljivim instrumentima i: A good display with legible instruments and clear navigation can be an excellent companion. The trouble begins when an ordinary action becomes a tour of the menus. When you have to search for information instead of seeing it. When animations and notifications obscure a basic function.
U salonu sve to može izgledati impresivn: It may all look impressive in the showroom. In the rain, wearing gloves and needing to get your eyes back on the road, the criteria are simpler: can I immediately see what I need, and can I do what I want?
Veličinu ekrana lako je napisati u katal: Screen size is easy to put in a catalogue. Natural throttle response is much harder. I worry that what is easier to demonstrate at a presentation too often takes priority over what you discover after two hundred kilometres.
A Euro 5 nikome nije naredio da ugradi t: And Euro 5 never ordered anyone to fit a television. The industry signs that part of the bill itself.
I stara Vespa zaslužuje razumnu raspravu: Even an old Vespa deserves a sensible discussion
Milano pokazuje koliko je odnos prema mo: Milan shows how attitudes towards motorcycles are more complicated than a label on a registration document. The city postponed the start of the ban in Areas B and C for Euro 2 and 3 two-strokes and Euro 0, 1 and 2 four-strokes until 1 October 2027.
Zdravlje stanovnika opravdan je razlog z: Residents' health is a legitimate reason for restrictions. At the same time, a historic Vespa used for occasional rides deserves a discussion that considers how much it is actually used. Its cultural value does not cancel its emissions, but it can justify carefully considered exemptions.
Takav argument ima više težine od tvrdnj: That argument carries more weight than claiming an old vehicle does not pollute because we love it. Precisely because we love it, we should be able to defend it with better arguments.
Razlog da se još jednom okreneš: A reason to look back once more
Od modernog motocikla očekujem dobre koč: I expect a modern motorcycle to have good brakes, reliable starting, quality suspension and electronics that help when needed. Alongside all that, I want a reason for a Sunday ride with no destination.
Zvuk koji prepoznam. Agregat koji ima sv: A sound I recognise. An engine with its own rhythm. A corner exit that stays with me longer than the welcome animation.
Proizvođači znaju pokazati koliko je mot: Manufacturers know how to show that a motorcycle is cleaner, faster and more connected. I would like them to show just as convincingly why I will want to ride it as soon as I find a little time.
Kad siđem s njega, želim se još jednom o: When I get off, I want to turn back, look at the motorcycle and smile. As for the screen in my living room, I already have a remote.
